ITEM 1 | Flaked light-brown fish-like mass with pale creamy-white edges on the left-center of the plate, mostly covered by red onion rings; moist, soft, flaky texture with some translucent white bits, roughly 9 cm by 6 cm footprint and about 2 cm thick | 120
ITEM 2 | Thinly sliced red onion rings, bright magenta-purple edges with white centers, glossy and moist, lying in loose overlapping curls over the fish and rice, about 10 cm across | 25
ITEM 3 | Pale tan-beige grainy mixture with small flecks of orange and white, crumbly and moist, piled in a mound at the upper right, about 9 cm by 6 cm and roughly 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 4 | Small whole cherry tomatoes, glossy red with some darker red shading, smooth skin, halved or whole, clustered on the left side of the plate in a group about 6 cm across | 80
ITEM 5 | Dark purple-brown whole olives, wrinkled glossy skins, scattered in a short curved row at the lower left, about 8 cm long | 45
ITEM 6 | Finely shredded orange carrot strands, bright orange, matte with slight moisture, forming a dense heap about 8 cm by 6 cm and about 2 cm high, with a few loose strands spreading outward | 70
ITEM 7 | Bright green whole green beans, slightly wilted, glossy with a few darker spots, trimmed ends, arranged in a diagonal bundle along the right side about 12 cm long and 6 cm wide | 65
ITEM 8 | Pale white creamy soft cheese-like piece with slightly yellowish edges, smooth and moist, sitting partly under the fish, about 4 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick | 30
